newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Moslem rebels attack army camps in south Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Moslem rebels attack army camps in south Philippines.

text.p: Moslem rebels simultaneously attacked three army camps in the southern Philippines, killing one soldier and seriously wounding three, the military said on Friday.

Southern military command chief Romeo Padiernos said the guerrillas of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) suffered an undetermined number of casualties in fighting in three areas of North Cotabato province from early Wednesday to midnight.
He said about 30 guerrillas carried out the first attack while smaller groups attacked two other military camps.
The incidents occurred during a break in peace talks between Manila and the MILF, which is fighting for an Islamic state in the southern islands.
